result.title: GTA: Generative Tower of Agents for Scalable Holonic Scene Generation
result.summary: Scalable world modeling requires coordinating scene-wide goals with fine-grained objects and dynamic characters under limited time and context budgets. We introduce GTA (Generative Tower of Agents), which represents every unit at every level of an adaptive scene hierarchy as a holon, both a self-contained construction task and a composable scene unit. Parallel agents recursively plan the hierarchy top-down, generate assets, and assemble and refine them bottom-up. Uniform interfaces carry scene-wide requirements down the hierarchy, guiding local construction so that each holon fits into the larger one. GTA accelerates scalable world modeling through high-throughput parallel execution while preserving well-structured layouts and fine-grained asset details. GTA then populates the assembled environments with dynamic human characters whose appearance and motion are guided by the scene, yielding realized 4D worlds. Project page: https://zt-zeng-tao.github.io/GTA/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GTA：把自适应场景层级中每一级单元表示为既自成任务又可组合的 holon，由并行 agent 自顶向下递归规划、生成素材，再自底向上组装与精修，并向环境中填充受场景引导的动态人物以获得 4D 世界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「统一接口逐级下传全局约束、子单元可组合」的层级状态组织方式，可能为 LVR 中分层 latent 状态的表示与全局—局部条件传播提供类比线索，但该文面向场景生成而非 VLM 推理，能否迁移尚需核查。
